[Shot 1] The single continuous take opens exactly where <Video 1> opens, a medium shot of the dancing figure inside <Subject 2>, the wrecked room with cracked walls, jagged red-glowing holes, magenta sofas, and a leaning mattress. The dancer is now <Subject 1>, the young man with long black hair held by a gold hairpin and layered teal-and-blue hanfu robes, replacing the original black-suited figure while performing the identical choreography. The camera pulls back to a full-body frontal view as <Subject 1> raises both arms above his head with bent elbows and spreads his legs into the first pose, his wide sleeves and red tassels swinging with the motion. The camera drops to a low angle behind him and tilts up as he arches his back and thrusts his arms upward beneath a glowing dome lamp, the hem of his robes flaring outward. The camera rolls into a Dutch angle and arcs around his body while he twists his torso and crosses his sweeping arms, his long black hair and blue ribbon whipping through the air. The camera pushes to an extreme low angle from behind as he bends forward at the waist, his layered robes folding over his back while thin orange ember sparks streak through the room. The camera rises to a high angle as he crouches and lunges forward with a sweeping arm strike, his calm face from <Picture 1> clearly visible. The camera tilts to a top-down Dutch angle as he leans far to one side with both arms extended and sleeves trailing, then swings back to a low rolling angle as he spins with one leg kicked out and robes swirling around him.
